task.name: scroll bars
task.prompt: Refine scrollbar.css: thin neutral desktop scrollbars (WebKit and Firefox), overlay vs stable gutter option, corner treatment, optional custom-scrollbar JS fallback. Requirement: scrollbars match design.txt weight and look identical in the C# and C++ hosts.
task.requirements: Thin neutral desktop scrollbars applied to every scroll container in a zUI window; identical across the WebView2-based C# and C++ hosts; stable-gutter and overlay opt-ins available.
task.notes: Reworked scrollbar.css: styling now applies to all descendants of .zui-window (not just .zui-scroll), 12px thin track/thumb with 3px inset, hover/active thumb states, min thumb length, horizontal track border, step buttons hidden. Added .zui-scroll--stable (scrollbar-gutter: stable) and .zui-scroll--overlay (transparent overlay bars for dense grids). Firefox scrollbar-color fallback for non-Chromium hosts; both bindings use WebView2/Chromium so the WebKit pseudo-elements are the identical path. Dark-theme thumb colour under prefers-color-scheme.

task.name: dropdowns and selects
task.prompt: Flesh out dropdown.css and zui.js select behaviour: single/multi select, keyboard nav (arrows/home/end/type-ahead), disabled and checked items, submenu support, popover positioning that stays on screen. Requirement: keyboard-operable select and a shared popover menu used by menubar and context menus.
task.requirements: Keyboard-operable select, and one shared popover-menu renderer (zui.menu) used by dropdowns, the menu bar and context menus.
task.notes: zui.menu is already the single renderer for select/menubar/context menus; added full keyboard operation to it: focus moves to the menu on open, ArrowUp/Down/Home/End move the active item, Enter/Space activate, Escape closes, printable keys do prefix type-ahead (600ms window), disabled items skipped. Select trigger: Enter/Space/ArrowDown opens and highlights the first item. Menu-bar items: tabindex, Enter/Space/ArrowDown opens; ArrowLeft/Right walk to the adjacent top-level menu while open. Popover stays on-screen (existing clamp).

task.name: create a scripting language
task.prompt: the ui itself will be defined by a scripting language, this will compile down to native code for performance
task.requirements: A .zsl language with a documented grammar and an ahead-of-time compiler (no runtime interpretation) that emits a working zUI document and native C#/C++ host code; example programs compile and compiler tests pass.
task.notes: Designed ZSL (zUI Scripting Language) + zslc.py compiler. compiler/GRAMMAR.md: lexical spec + EBNF grammar (nodes map to zUI components; bind:/source=/-> for bindings, list repetition and events). compiler/zslc.py: regex lexer, recursive-descent parser to Program{roots,state,handlers}, and 3 codegen backends - html (self-contained zUI doc + generated glue JS wiring state/events/tables to the zui.js message bus), csharp (auto-gen partial class embedding the compiled doc + typed On_<event> partial hooks for a ZuiHost), cpp (translation unit with the doc as a raw string literal + on_<event> callbacks for zui::Host). AOT: the .zsl and parser are never shipped. examples/counter.zsl + examples/showcase.zsl compile on all backends; examples/generated/ holds sample output. compiler/tests/test_compile.py (5 tests, lexer/parser/errors/all backends) passes. build.ps1 compiles examples and runs compiler tests in the test config.

task.name: project overview
task.prompt: your task is to create a visual UI subsystem that will sit on top of my other apps providing a consistent UI experience, at the start we will base the visual design on googles holoUI however other themes may be added later. Plan to add widgets, forms, dropdowns, buttons, fonts, colors, etc. I will leave infrastructure up to you but perhaps use css and build plugins for both C++ and C# so that either language can use the library and get an identical experience. For now build the base systems to get everything up and running, and create a seperate app that showcases any forms and ui elements we make. keep in mind we will be using this in a music app, a game engine, and a project managment app so make the scalable, universal, and effecient.
task.requirements: bones of system are up and running
task.notes: Established zUI base architecture: CSS design-token system (core/css/tokens.css) + base reset, 14 component stylesheets (button, panel, window shell, dropdown/menu, scrollbar, menubar, tabs/nav, table/list, input, layout, tooltip/cursor, notification/toast, loading, drop-target/empty), single-import core/css/zui.css, holo theme (+ dark scaffold).
